title: Check the frame before handing over
text: For every piece, look at what the frame actually shows (a reframed 16:9 source loses its edges). A cut that's right on time can still show nothing. (Confirmed on 1RaceClub; applying it beyond Shorts is a guess.)
confirm: Which rendered frames were looked at for each reframed piece?
probe: **M-5. Check the frame before handing over.**
